title: Build Output Validation and Staging Repair
changes: Exclude generated Build application folders from project JSON validation using case-insensitive path ownership rules.
Prune dependency tests, JSONC configuration, node_modules, and Git internals from staged client/editor content.
Clean stale dependency-development paths from existing generated application folders during workspace preflight.
Extend validator self-tests and Windows build portability checks for the corrected ownership contract.
